description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class `ClientNotFoundException` used in the Fineract project to signal that client resources were not found. The class extends `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` and provides multiple constructors for different scenarios of client not found errors.

classes.name: ClientNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a client with a specified identifier or details was not found in the system. It extends a platform-specific base exception to integrate with the application's exception handling framework.

methods.name: ClientNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating a client with a specific ID does not exist.

methods.name: ClientNotFoundException(ExternalId externalId)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating a client with a specific external ID does not exist.

methods.name: ClientNotFoundException()
methods.description: Constructs a generic exception indicating a client was not found with basic details.

methods.name: ClientNotFoundException(String value, String valueType)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating a client was not found based on a specified value and its type.

methods.name: ClientNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating a client with the given ID was not found, wrapping an underlying data access exception.
